Level 6 · Govern

Level 6: Principal Agentic Security and Governance Professional

Turn technical risk into accountable organisational decisions.

Open the live courseSee pathways

Three core lessons live; programme assessment in design

Who it is for
Security leaders, risk and compliance leads, product owners and senior architects.
Before you start
Levels 1 and 3, or equivalent senior experience.
Capstone evidence
An enterprise agentic security programme with policy and control architecture, a risk and impact assessment, a supplier assurance pack, a board paper and an independent oral defence.
How it is assessed
Programme review and an oral defence before independent assessors.

Modules and evidence

Each module ends in an artefact that goes into your portfolio.

ModuleYou will be able toEvidence
Governance operating modelName the accountable, risk, system, model or provider, data and control owners, plus legal, privacy, procurement and audit.Operating-model chart
AI inventory and classificationClassify use cases by autonomy, tool permissions, data classes, affected parties, criticality, third parties and jurisdiction.AI inventory
Management-system integrationIntegrate ISO/IEC 42001 with risk and impact processes informed by ISO/IEC 23894 and 42005, and with ISO/IEC 27001.Management-system mapping
Risk appetite for autonomous actionSet prohibited actions, human-approval tiers, service criticality and residual-risk acceptance.Risk appetite statement
Procurement and vendor oversightReview model and API terms, data use, subprocessor chains, breach notice, audit rights, model-change notice and exit plans.Supplier assurance pack
Board reporting and workforceReport exposure, incidents, control effectiveness and investment priorities; align roles to NICE tasks, knowledge and skills.Board paper

Live lessons for this level

3 lessons in the live course are currently mapped to this level.

  • 18Governance, regulation and enterprise risk
  • 19Securing agentic AI in critical industries
  • 20Capstone: design and assure a secure agentic enterprise

The free lessons open without payment. Lesson order inside the course is by module, not by level.

Planned lessons

These lessons are specified but not yet published. They address gaps identified in the curriculum review.

  • P10Sector safety and operational technology boundaries Planned
    Safety engineering, human factors, OT boundaries and service continuity, so a security control cannot create an unsafe condition.
  • P11The Secure Agentic Enterprise Dossier: building the portfolio Planned
    The single evolving portfolio the academy uses as evidence: templates, validation, versioning and export, introduced at Level 1 and extended at every level.

External mapping

Related published credentials, as benchmarks and optional pathways only.

Credential or frameworkHow we use it
IAPP AIGPAI governance benchmark. Not a hands-on security engineering credential.
ISC2 AI Security CertificationEmerging six-domain benchmark spanning AI concepts, governance, data and model security, architecture, operations and testing; pilot stage as of November 2026.
ISACA CISM, CRISC and CISAManagement, risk and audit benchmarks. Experience and continuing-education requirements apply.
ISO/IEC 42001 and 27001Teach implementation and audit readiness. A learner credential does not make an organisation certified.

Governance claims are tied to dated sources: the EU AI Act timetable changed in 2026, so every date shown here carries a review date.
